what: Single stylized toon right hand (wrist to mid-forearm), player's hand for repite-y-tranca.
art_direction: stylized toon cartoon game art, rounded simple shapes, clean matte colors, big expressive appeal, friendly mobile-game look
reference_review: Read OK: a stylized toon 3D render of a relaxed right hand, warm terracotta / deep brown matte skin, pale rounded fingernails, fingers gently drooping and curled, wrist cut off cleanly at mid-forearm to the right of frame, plain light-grey backdrop. All five digits present, no defects. Used directly as the image-to-3D input.

pipeline.preview: node studio/shot.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:4174/assets/props/_view/viewer.html?m=<web.glb>" <preview.png> 12000 1024 1024   (4 orthogonal views + 3/4, headless Edge)

handedness_and_orientation.convention: glTF/three.js Y-up, right-handed; +Y is up. Model is centred on the origin.
handedness_and_orientation.up_axis_+Y: back of the hand (dorsal side). Palm faces -Y.
handedness_and_orientation.fingers_point: +Z (fingertips at z = +0.50; index finger is the longest, reaching the +Z extreme)
handedness_and_orientation.wrist_end: -Z, cut flat at the mid-forearm (z = -0.50). This is the axis to socket into a forearm.
handedness_and_orientation.longest_axis: Z, exactly 1.000 unit (Tripo normalises the longest side to 1.0)
how_measured: gltf-transform decoded the meshopt+quantised positions; bbox computed from every vertex in world space.
Independent cross-check: the render page recomputes Box3 from the loaded GLB in three.js and prints it; both agree exactly (X 0.560, Y 0.535, Z 1.000, min [-0.280, -0.267, -0.500]).
Fingers vs wrist and the thumb side were confirmed visually on player-hand-preview.png (4 orthogonal views) and player-hand-orientation.png (labelled top-down, screen-up = +Z).
handedness_and_orientation.gameplay_note: For a first-person seat, place the hand at the player's edge of the table with the wrist end (-Z) toward the player and fingers (+Z) reaching the board. Scale by 1/1.0 for a hand ~1.0 unit long; a real hand+wrist is ~0.20-0.25 m.

performance_note: 749,302 triangles (the v3.1 source was 1,498,606; --simplify-ratio 0.5 halves it). Heavy for mobile web — re-run the same optimize command with --simplify-ratio 0.1 for ~150k tris at no credit cost if the frame budget is tight.
name: player-hand

bounds_world_units.note: Y-up, centred on origin; longest side normalised to 1.0 unit by Tripo.

visual_verdict: STRONG. Reads exactly as the reference: warm deep-brown matte skin, rounded toon forms, five fingers in a relaxed gentle curl, pale rounded nails, clean flat wrist cut. Clean silhouette in all four orthogonal views, no holes, no artifacts, no stray geometry. Ships as-is.

rig_check.verdict: NOT riggable (rig_type 'others'). Expected for a single hand; taken as-is and not rigged, per brief. Any finger motion must be authored by hand or the mesh split at the wrist.
